description: Create a New Quiz (LTI) in a Canvas course. Returns the created quiz with its id, assignment_id, and current field values. New Quizzes is Canvas's current quiz engine; there is no tool here to create a Classic quiz — list_quizzes, get_quiz, and delete_quiz only read and delete that older type. After creating, add questions with create_new_quiz_item, change title, dates, or points with update_new_quiz, and remove the quiz with delete_new_quiz. Each call creates another quiz (not idempotent), so check list_quizzes before retrying. Requires permission to manage quizzes in the course.

instructions.description: HTML instructions shown before the quiz starts

points_possible.description: Total points; defaults to sum of item points

published.description: Whether the quiz is visible to students

name: create_new_quiz
title: Create New Quiz
